name: NGC 1652 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 1652, an intermediate-age star cluster in the Large Magellanic Cloud, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc1652-hubble
story: A cluster of stars in the Large Magellanic Cloud, one of a set of clusters astronomers searched for signs of more than one generation of stars. Unlike most of the set, its stars showed no such spread within their measurements.

claims.text: NGC 1652 is one of 16 intermediate-age LMC clusters studied for multiple stellar populations
Most (11 of 16) of the clusters show an anomalous spread or split around the turnoff
NGC 1652's color-magnitude diagram shows no evidence of spread or bimodality
NGC 1652 is an LMC cluster imaged with ACS in program 9891
LMC stands for the Large Magellanic Cloud
